# Roo Code Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Roo Code configuration. The main output is `.roorules`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - roo
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - roo:
      version: full
```

## Overview

| Property        | Value       |
| --------------- | ----------- |
| **Tier**        | Tier 1      |
| **Main output** | `.roorules` |
| **Skills**      | No          |
| **Agents**      | No          |
| **Commands**    | No          |
| **Local files** | No          |

## Output Files

| File              | Path        | Purpose           |
| ----------------- | ----------- | ----------------- |
| Main instructions | `.roorules` | Primary rule file |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                             |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .roorules file              |
| `multifile`      | .roorules + .roo/mcp_settings.json |
| `full` (default) | .roorules + .roo/mcp_settings.json |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support                         |
| ------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | `.roo/mcp_settings.json` (json) |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported                   |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
